correctness.rationale: Tame four-point Kummer cover genus by Riemann–Hurwitz is 4, with basis dx/y², dx/y³, dx/y⁴, x dx/y⁴ certified by branch/infinity valuations. Cartier inverse Frobenius sends e1 to λ^{2/3}e3+(1+λ)^{1/3}e4, e2 to 0, e3 to -(1+λ)^{1/3}e2, e4 to λ^{1/3}e2. Hence rank2; semilinearly composing gives the ninth power of the sole nonzero C² coefficient equal to -λ²(1+λ)(λ-1)² in F_3[λ]. Since smooth λ excludes 0 and 1, its only root is -1, and C³=0. Independently rebuilt the coefficient polynomial and checked the exact characteristic-three factorization; no inference from finite extension sampling.

value.rationale: Within a natural, already studied genus-four cyclic quintic moduli family, the exact parameter where the nilpotence Jordan chain changes is a complete sharp Ekedahl–Oort-relevant boundary invariant. A rank-one versus rank-zero second iterate, despite constant p-rank and a-number, distinguishes otherwise inseparable invariants and is useful for identifying special fibers; no new generic Newton theorem is claimed.

final_claim: In char 3, for y^5=x(x-1)(x-λ) at smooth λ ≠0,1, genus 4 Cartier has rank 2, square-rank zero exactly at λ=-1 and one elsewhere, cube zero everywhere, a-number 2 and 3-rank 0.
